macos: Place your legally obtained US ROM as zelda3.sfc in the Z3R folder.
After venv activation, press the install dependencies button
Install SDL2 development files with your OS package manager before building.
Press the Build assets button. It extracts assets, compiles zelda3_assets.dat, and builds the executable. When it finishes, go back to the home menu to Play or Randomize.
windows: Place your legally obtained US ROM as zelda3.sfc in the Z3R folder.
Make sure MSBuild is installed, or use the Manual install button beside any missing dependency check.
After venv activation, press the install dependencies button
Use Visual Studio Build Tools with Desktop development with C++ or the TCC package route before building.
Press the Build assets button. It extracts assets, compiles zelda3_assets.dat, and builds zelda3.exe. When it finishes, go back to the home menu to Play or Randomize.
